riskAcceptance: The site owner explicitly accepts the copyright and takedown risk of displaying source-provided card images that do not have a recorded display licence. This does not change their rights status or represent them as licensed.
policy: Metadata collection and image display are separate permissions. Runtime collection is allowed only for an explicitly enabled source. A discovered image URL is never treated as permission to display it.

sources.name: Pokémon TCG API
sources.notes: API use is allowed subject to its terms; the API terms do not independently establish card-art display rights.

sources.name: TCGdex API
sources.notes: Use for metadata and Traditional Chinese matching. Image display remains unclassified until explicit terms are recorded.

sources.name: TCGdex 轉供 Cardmarket 價格
sources.notes: ADR 0036: live per-card lookup of TCGdex variants_detailed[].pricing.cardmarket (EUR; trend as market, low as listing), shown only for tcgdex-ja cards, cached in memory for 24 hours, never stored, dropped when older than 7 days. The licence chain is unclear: Cardmarket may not have authorised TCGdex to relay these prices, so risk-accepted is not a licence. Set collectionEnabled to false to stop.
